With a monthly subscription to DIRECTV Sports Pack, you get access to specialty sports networks, pro networks, plus adventure programming, international soccer, golf, tennis, racing and more.  Also included, for those with a base package of CHOICE and above, access to up to 35 out-of-market regional sports networks to view select live collegiate and high school games, as well as pre- and post-game commentary for select pro teams around the country. *
